text:
Sam: Starting thread — bulk envelope re-encrypt job is hitting KMS rate limits and we're seeing gaps in audit logs for a GCP key.
Marta: @Sam can you paste the tail of the job log? rough counts and error types ok.
Sam: Logs: ```2025-09-21T14:02:12Z ERROR reencrypter: Encrypt failed: rpc error: code=ResourceExhausted desc="quota exceeded"; key=gcp://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck v=1``` Also a handful of 403s for service account.
Ryan: 403s sound like RBAC — which service account is running the batch? did we rotate the worker SA recently?
Sam: It's `redwood-rekeyer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Policy looks ok at a glance but there was an org-policy change last week.
Anya: If RBAC changed we need to confirm Audit Logs for iam.serviceAccounts.setIamPolicy for last 7 days. @Lee can you pull audit entries?
Lee: On it. pulling Cloud Audit and Cloud Asset snapshots. Also checking AWS CloudTrail for the parallel worker role.
Sam: Root cause seems mixed: GCP returned quota, AWS workers got throttled (KMS ThrottlingExceeded), and some envelopes failed mid-transform leaving partial state.
Marta: Partial state is scary. We need idempotence and a checkpointing plan before resuming. Current job writes progress every 5k envelopes, maybe reduce to 1k and make checkpoints atomic.
Ryan: Suggestion: checkpoint per-shard to S3 with manifest files: `{shard, last_processed_id, success_count, failed_count, checkpoint_ts}` and a separate DLQ for items that hit 5 retries.
Anya: Audit requirement: ensure every re-encrypt operation emits an audit event with original key id, new key id, envelope id, and actor. Must be stored in immutable store for 365 days.
Sam: We can emit to our internal audit-topic (kafka) and sink to GCS/Azure blob with WORM. I'll add the extra attributes.
Marta: Throttling strategy: per-tenant token bucket and global concurrency cap by KMS provider. e.g., AWS KMS concurrency 500 rps max across cluster, GCP 120 rps, Azure 200 rps — need to verify precise quotas.
Lee: Also add jitter and exponential backoff for transient 429/ResourceExhausted, but treat 403/permission denied as hard fail and move to DLQ for manual triage.
Sam: For resumability: job should be able to resume from the last manifest checkpoint. Implement a fast-scan mode that reads manifest files and enqueues only missing ids.
Anya: Add a verification pass after re-encrypt: pick random sample (canary) per tenant 100 envelopes and validate decrypt(new) == decrypt(old) under their keys. Record a hash diff metric.
Ryan: Monitoring: metrics to create - `reencrypt.processed_total`, `reencrypt.failed_total`, `reencrypt.dlq_total`, `reencrypt.latency_p95`, `reencrypt.audit_events_emitted`. Alert on DLQ > 50 in 5m or failure rate > 1% for > 10m.
Marta: Runbook actions: pause job (write pause flag in config store), scale down workers, grant temporary increased quotas with cloud provider support if we need emergency catch-up, then resume with lower concurrency.
Sam: For RBAC issues: add a preflight RBAC check that verifies `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.encrypt` (GCP) / `kms:Encrypt` & `kms:ReEncrypt` (AWS) / `wrapKey` (Azure) for the worker principal before processing shard.
Anya: Also require that the KMS key rotation window is compatible — if a key is rotated during migration we need key version metadata in audit event to ensure traceability.
Lee: Implement dead-letter retention policy and a small remediation UI for ops to requeue after fix. Add idempotent requeue operation so reprocessing won't double-encrypt.
Sam: Small deploy plan: canary 10k envelopes for one non-critical tenant, validate audit records, sampling checks, then ramp to 1% of load for 24h, then full commit.
Marta: I'll add the checkpoint frequency change and DLQ wiring to the infra backlog. @Sam can you open a quick PR with the manifest schema and the preflight RBAC check? link it here.
Sam: Will do — PR coming in next 30m. Also creating incident chat channel if anything spikes: #inc-reencrypt-1768204567.
Anya: One more: ensure CloudTrail/Audit Logs retention policy covers the export window; if not, export to long-term archive immediately before we resume.
Ryan: Noted. I'll also request quota increase tickets for AWS KMS and GCP KMS as backup. expect reply 1-2 business days.
Sam: Thanks all. Action items: Sam PR, Marta infra change, Lee audit pull, Ryan quotas, Anya retention policy. We'll reconvene after PR lands. :thumbsup:
